techniques.name: Question hook
techniques.description: Opens with a spoken or displayed question.

techniques.name: Bold claim
techniques.description: Opens with an assertive claim intended to draw attention.

techniques.name: Curiosity gap
techniques.description: Opens by withholding an answer or outcome explicitly promised later.

techniques.name: Result first
techniques.description: Shows or states an outcome before explaining how it happened.

techniques.name: Problem statement
techniques.description: Opens by naming a problem to be addressed.

techniques.name: Story opening
techniques.description: Opens by setting up a narrated event or situation.

techniques.name: Visual hook
techniques.description: Opens with a salient visual before or alongside explanatory content.

techniques.name: Talking head
techniques.description: Speaker addresses the camera for a substantial part of the video.

techniques.name: Tutorial
techniques.description: Explains a process or teaches a skill in steps.

techniques.name: Product demonstration
techniques.description: Shows a product or service in use.

techniques.name: Storytime
techniques.description: Narrates an event as the main format.

techniques.name: List format
techniques.description: Presents numbered or clearly enumerated items.

techniques.name: Reaction
techniques.description: Responds to another piece of content or event.

techniques.name: Before and after
techniques.description: Compares a state before and after a change.

techniques.name: Screen recording
techniques.description: Recorded screen is a principal visual source.

techniques.name: Interview
techniques.description: Question and answer exchange is a principal format.

techniques.name: Jump cut
techniques.description: Abrupt cut within a continuous subject or setup.

techniques.name: Punch in
techniques.description: Abrupt reframing to a closer crop of the same shot.

techniques.name: B-roll
techniques.description: Supporting footage overlays or interrupts the main action.

techniques.name: Speed ramp
techniques.description: Playback speed visibly changes within a shot.

techniques.name: Freeze frame
techniques.description: A held still frame interrupts moving footage.

techniques.name: Split screen
techniques.description: Two or more distinct visual regions display simultaneously.

techniques.name: Captions
techniques.description: On-screen text follows spoken words.

techniques.name: Headline
techniques.description: Prominent on-screen title summarizes or frames the content.

techniques.name: Keyword emphasis
techniques.description: Selected words receive distinct visual emphasis.

techniques.name: Text reveal
techniques.description: Text appears progressively as an editing device.

techniques.name: Pattern interrupt
techniques.description: Presentation changes abruptly to interrupt an established visual or audio pattern.

techniques.name: Voiceover
techniques.description: Speech is heard without the speaker speaking on screen.

techniques.name: Direct speech
techniques.description: A visible person speaks in the scene.

techniques.name: Music
techniques.description: Music is audible during the interval.

techniques.name: Sound effect
techniques.description: Non-speech, non-music effect is audible.

techniques.name: Beat-synced edit
techniques.description: A visual edit coincides with an audible musical beat.

techniques.name: Verbal call to action
techniques.description: Spoken request asks the viewer to act.

techniques.name: Visual call to action
techniques.description: Visible request asks the viewer to act.

techniques.name: Follow request
techniques.description: Requests a follow or subscription.

techniques.name: Save request
techniques.description: Requests that the viewer save the content.

techniques.name: Comment request
techniques.description: Requests a comment.

techniques.name: Share request
techniques.description: Requests that the viewer share the content.

techniques.name: Product action
techniques.description: Requests a product-related action such as a visit or purchase.

techniques.name: Face to camera
techniques.description: A person faces the camera directly.

techniques.name: Product foreground
techniques.description: Product is prominent in the frame.

techniques.name: Close-up
techniques.description: Subject fills much of the frame.

techniques.name: Wide shot
techniques.description: Frame shows broad surroundings around the subject.

techniques.name: Screen content
techniques.description: A device or software screen is visible.

techniques.name: Multiple subjects
techniques.description: Two or more principal subjects share the frame.
